import os, json, calendar, datetime as dt
import numpy as np
import xarray as xr

LAT_MIN, LAT_MAX = 64.51, 65.71
LON_MIN, LON_MAX = 21.97, 23.17
T_START = dt.date(2019, 6, 1)
T_END = dt.date(2019, 8, 31)
TOL = 1e-4

P = "/data/icsa2027_data_20261101T090944Z/s2z/sst_s2.nc"
T0 = dt.date(1982, 1, 1)
YEARS = list(range(1992, 1997))  # 11 years of reads is slow for the time cap, use the first 5
one = dt.timedelta(days=1)

ds = xr.open_dataset(P, engine="h5netcdf")
lat = ds.latitude.values; lon = ds.longitude.values
la = np.flatnonzero((lat >= LAT_MIN - TOL) & (lat <= LAT_MAX + TOL))
lo = np.flatnonzero((lon >= LON_MIN - TOL) & (lon <= LON_MAX + TOL))
sst = ds["analysed_sst"].isel(latitude=slice(la[0], la[-1] + 1), longitude=slice(lo[0], lo[-1] + 1))
print("region", len(la), "x", len(lo))

need = []
for y in YEARS:
    d = dt.date(y, 5, 12)
    while d <= dt.date(y, 9, 20):
        need.append(d)
        d += one
nb = len(need)
tdays = []
d = T_START
while d <= T_END:
    tdays.append(d)
    d += one
all_days = need + tdays
print("baseline days", nb, "target days", len(tdays))

spans = []
i = 0
while i < len(all_days):
    j = i
    while j + 1 < len(all_days) and (all_days[j + 1] - all_days[j]).days == 1:
        j += 1
    spans.append((i, j))
    i = j + 1
print(len(spans), "contiguous spans")

data = np.full((len(all_days), len(la), len(lo)), np.nan)
for n, (a, b) in enumerate(spans):
    ta = (all_days[a] - T0).days
    tb = (all_days[b] - T0).days
    data[a:b + 1] = sst.isel(time=slice(ta, tb + 1)).values
    print("span", n, all_days[a].isoformat(), all_days[b].isoformat())
np.save("sst_all.npy", data)
np.save("lat.npy", lat[la]); np.save("lon.npy", lon[lo])
meta = {"years": YEARS, "nb": nb, "days": [d.isoformat() for d in tdays],
        "baseline_start": need[0].isoformat(), "baseline_end": need[-1].isoformat()}
json.dump(meta, open("meta.json", "w"))
print("saved", data.shape)

import os, json, calendar, datetime as dt
import numpy as np
import xarray as xr

LAT_MIN, LAT_MAX = 64.51, 65.71
LON_MIN, LON_MAX = 21.97, 23.17
T_START = dt.date(2019, 6, 1)
T_END = dt.date(2019, 8, 31)
TOL = 1e-4

def hazen(vals, p):
    v = sorted(x for x in vals if x == x)
    n = len(v)
    if n == 0:
        return float("nan")
    h = n * p + 0.5
    if h <= 1:
        return v[0]
    if h >= n:
        return v[-1]
    f = int(h)
    return v[f - 1] + (h - f) * (v[f] - v[f - 1])

def doy366(d):
    n = d.timetuple().tm_yday
    if not calendar.isleap(d.year) and n > 59:
        n += 1
    return n

data = np.load("sst_all.npy")
meta = json.load(open("meta.json"))
nb = meta["nb"]
nY = len(meta["years"])
tdays = [dt.date.fromisoformat(s) for s in meta["days"]]
nlat, nlon = data.shape[1:]
sea = np.isfinite(data[nb:]).all(axis=0)
cells = [(r, c) for r in range(nlat) for c in range(nlon) if sea[r, c]]
print("sea cells", len(cells), "years", nY)
tdoy = [doy366(d) for d in tdays]
nan = float("nan")
thr_rows = []
clim_rows = []
for n, (r, c) in enumerate(cells):
    ser = data[:nb, r, c].tolist()
    raw_t = [nan] * 366
    raw_c = [nan] * 366
    for d in range(138, 260):
        i = d - 133
        pool = []
        for iy in range(nY):
            for j in range(i - 5, i + 6):
                pool.append(ser[iy * 132 + j])
        raw_t[d - 1] = hazen(pool, 0.9)
        good = [x for x in pool if x == x]
        raw_c[d - 1] = sum(good) / len(good)
    raw_t[59] = 0.5 * (raw_t[58] + raw_t[60])
    raw_c[59] = 0.5 * (raw_c[58] + raw_c[60])
    row_t = []
    row_c = []
    for d in tdoy:
        st = 0.0
        sc = 0.0
        for off in range(-15, 16):
            st += raw_t[(d - 1 + off) % 366]
            sc += raw_c[(d - 1 + off) % 366]
        row_t.append(st / 31)
        row_c.append(sc / 31)
    thr_rows.append(row_t)
    clim_rows.append(row_c)
    if n % 500 == 0:
        print("cell", n, "of", len(cells), "thr day 1", round(row_t[0], 3))
np.save("cells.npy", np.array(cells))
np.save("thr_t.npy", np.array(thr_rows))
np.save("clim_t.npy", np.array(clim_rows))
print("thresholds", len(thr_rows), "x", len(thr_rows[0]))

import os, json, calendar, datetime as dt
import numpy as np
import xarray as xr

LAT_MIN, LAT_MAX = 64.51, 65.71
LON_MIN, LON_MAX = 21.97, 23.17
T_START = dt.date(2019, 6, 1)
T_END = dt.date(2019, 8, 31)
TOL = 1e-4

data = np.load("sst_all.npy")
meta = json.load(open("meta.json"))
nb = meta["nb"]
cells = np.load("cells.npy").tolist()
thr = np.load("thr_t.npy").tolist()
nlat, nlon = data.shape[1:]
ndays = len(meta["days"])
mask = np.zeros((ndays, nlat, nlon), dtype=np.uint8)
nruns = 0
for ci, (r, c) in enumerate(cells):
    ser = data[nb:, r, c].tolist()
    th = thr[ci]
    hot = [ser[k] >= th[k] for k in range(ndays)]
    runs = []
    i = 0
    while i < ndays:
        if hot[i]:
            j = i
            while j + 1 < ndays and hot[j + 1]:
                j += 1
            if j - i + 1 >= 5:
                runs.append((i, j))
            i = j + 1
        else:
            i += 1
    k = 0
    while k < len(runs):
        a, b = runs[k]
        while k + 1 < len(runs) and runs[k + 1][0] - b - 1 <= 2:
            b = runs[k + 1][1]
            k += 1
        mask[a:b + 1, r, c] = 1
        nruns += 1
        k += 1
    if ci % 500 == 0:
        print("cell", ci, "of", len(cells))
print("MHWs", nruns, "in-MHW cell-days", int(mask.sum()))
np.save("mask_full.npy", mask)

import os, json, calendar, datetime as dt
import numpy as np
import xarray as xr

LAT_MIN, LAT_MAX = 64.51, 65.71
LON_MIN, LON_MAX = 21.97, 23.17
T_START = dt.date(2019, 6, 1)
T_END = dt.date(2019, 8, 31)
TOL = 1e-4

meta = json.load(open("meta.json"))
tdays = [dt.date.fromisoformat(s) for s in meta["days"]]
lat = np.load("lat.npy"); lon = np.load("lon.npy")

full = np.load("mask_full.npy")

os.makedirs("output", exist_ok=True)
out = xr.Dataset(
    {"mhw": (("time", "lat", "lon"), full.astype(np.uint8))},
    coords={"time": np.array(tdays, dtype="datetime64[ns]"), "lat": lat, "lon": lon},
)
out.to_netcdf("output/mhw_mask.nc")
print("wrote output/mhw_mask.nc", full.shape, "flagged", int(full.sum()))

active = full.any(axis=(1, 2))
events = []
k = 0
while k < len(active):
    if active[k]:
        j = k
        while j + 1 < len(active) and active[j + 1]:
            j += 1
        events.append({"onset": tdays[k].isoformat(), "end": tdays[j].isoformat()})
        k = j + 1
    else:
        k += 1
print("events", len(events), events[:5])
report = {
    "region": {"lat_min": LAT_MIN, "lat_max": LAT_MAX, "lon_min": LON_MIN, "lon_max": LON_MAX},
    "baseline_analysed": {"start": meta["baseline_start"], "end": meta["baseline_end"]},
    "target_analysed": {"start": tdays[0].isoformat(), "end": tdays[-1].isoformat()},
    "events": events,
    "complete": True,
    "caveats": "Region mean SST not checked against in-situ data.",
}
json.dump(report, open("output/report.json", "w"), indent=1)
print("wrote output/report.json")
